source: input/karlsberg_1789_hms_2160p.webm (3840x2160, 60 fps container, 124.2 s; (c) Architekturvisualisierung Matzerath + Historisches Museum Saar — private use only)
notes: Times are source PTS in seconds. fps = recommended sampling rate for SfM / Gaussian splatting.
Shots marked effective_fps 30 were rendered at 30 fps and frame-doubled to 60 (mpdecimate): never sample above 30 there.
lighting 'day' shots share one sun/sky setup and may be combined into one reconstruction; 'golden' (S23) must be reconstructed separately or used for geometry only.
mask: regions to mask before feature extraction (text/labels/leader lines). Sky should be masked in all shots (CG sky + animated clouds).
Priority 1 = core set for the main palace; 2 = useful extension; 3 = optional/low value.

shots.subject: Ehrenhof + corps de logis + both arms + Kuechenbau from above (crane-up from court pavement to high oblique, slight lateral drift)
shots.why: Strongest parallax on the U-shaped main palace; roofs, dormers and court facades from many angles; consistent daylight; true 60 fps. Skip the first ~0.4 s (blurred pavement).
shots.mask: centre text 'Zerstoert durch franzoesische Revolutionstruppen 1793' t~19-22.5; label 'Kuechenbau' + leader line t~25.5-28.9

shots.subject: Near-nadir oblique of U, Sammlungsfluegel, Kuechenhof, Kuechenbau, Bildergalerie, rotunda, walled gardens
shots.why: Plan-like view, best single source for footprint layout; slow drift gives modest parallax; links S04 and S08 views.
shots.mask: label 'Sammlungsfluegel mit Bibliothek, ...' bottom third + leader line (whole shot)

shots.subject: High oblique of the whole residence from the west: U, Sammlungsfluegel, Orangerie, avenues, walled garden, Nutzbauten in background
shots.why: Context and long-baseline view tying palace, Orangerie and avenues together; no overlays.

shots.subject: Orangerie (foreground) and palace south arm / Ehrenhof, looking north along the avenue to the Nutzbauten
shots.why: Only good aerial of the Orangerie roof/plan; slow push-in with some rotation; overlaps S08.
shots.mask: label 'Orangerie: ein Festsaal ...' lower-left + leader line + circle marker on Orangerie roof (t~42.3-47.5)

shots.subject: Portico pavilion (NW court corner) close-up, then Ehrenhof facades: south arm, corps de logis, north arm at eye level
shots.why: Facade detail at ground level (portals, guard boxes, windows, plinth); dolly + pan gives some parallax. Near-field DOF/motion blur on columns t~9-12.
shots.mask: title 'Schloss Karlsberg in Homburg / erbaut ab 1777' lower centre t~13.8-18.05

shots.subject: Rise over Orangerie roof, aerial push to south arm outer facade with terrace garden, through its portal passage, across the court to the north arm court facade and its portal
shots.why: Only frontal elevation of an arm (21 axes countable) and of the north arm court facade; strong forward motion. Passage interiors (t~73.6-75.4, 78.6-79.4) are fast and textureless — drop them for SfM.
shots.mask: label 'Moderne Blitzableiter ...' t~68.8-69.5; label 'Herzoglicher Wohnfluegel ...' lower centre t~75.9-79.4

shots.subject: Kuechenhof from the north-arm passage, crane up over the Bildergalerie roof looking north to the walled Hofgaertnerei with Treibhaeuser
shots.why: Only view of the Kuechenhof interior facades and the Treibhaeuser; crane gives parallax.
shots.mask: label 'Die Treibhaeuser des Hofgaertners Ludwig Reichard' upper centre + leader line t~81.5-84.85

shots.subject: Orangerie west facade at eye level: ashlar basement, pedimented risalit, Dachreiter
shots.why: Facade detail of the Orangerie; lateral truck gives parallax; fog cards in background.
shots.mask: label 'Moderne Blitzableiter Hemmer'sche Fuenfspitzen' upper left t~65.5-68.75

shots.subject: Nadir pan along the Nutzbauten/Marstall row and the avenue north of the palace
shots.why: Orthophoto-like coverage of outbuilding footprints; little parallax (nadir), good for a 2.5D map, poor for facades. Hard cut at 50.25 — treat as two sub-sequences.

shots.subject: Nadir view of the north end of the residence / start of the Appelallee to Park Karlslust
shots.why: Footprints of northern outbuildings; nadir only.
shots.mask: label 'Appelallee: fuehrt in den Park Karlslust' bottom + leader line (whole shot)

shots.subject: Low flight up the slope to the red-roofed Nutzbauten (Lazarett, Kasernen, Brauerei)
shots.why: Only oblique facades of the Nutzbauten; motion blur on grass, fog cards. Possible dissolve near 58.3.
shots.mask: label 'Nutzbauten fuer das Schloss ...' lower left t~55.5-60.95

shots.subject: Eye-level views: Sammlungsfluegel west front with portal (87.6-90.2), meadow with animated deer, terrace wall, Orangerie (90.2-95.3)
shots.why: Supplementary ground views; trees occlude, animated animals and fog — mask or skip. Hard cuts at 90.18 and 92.92.

shots.subject: Slow aerial arc from the garden (east) side around and over the whole palace, ending near-nadir
shots.why: Longest continuous orbit-like move (16 s) with large baseline over the complete complex; but low backlit sun, haze and bloom (t~100.7-104 nearly silhouetted). Reconstruct separately from the daylight set.
shots.mask: label 'Bildergalerie mit anschliessender Rotunde' t~103.8-108; label 'Blick in den Englischen Garten von Bernhard Petri' t~108.5-113.3 (fades in/out); sun/sky

excluded.why: S01/S02 eye-level dolly through trees toward the palace; heavy foliage occlusion, fade from dark at ~3.8-4.8, camera passes through foliage at ~8.0-8.6. Usable only as reference.
S05 ground dolly beside the Orangerie with dense animated fog/dust cards; 30 fps effective.
S07 Schlossallee view: starts inside foliage, text overlay top right, low parallax.
S18 fast low flight over grass/trees: strong motion blur, no buildings.
S22 Marstall top-down: from ~96.3 the grade bleaches to near-white (transition), inconsistent appearance.
